name: Question 14
worked_solution:
We multiply each entry of $M$ by $\frac{2}{3}$ and each entry of $N$ by $2,$ and then add the resulting matrices, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{3}M+2N & =\frac{2}{3}[\begin{aligned}6 & 0 & 15 \\ -12 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}]+2[\begin{aligned}3 & -1 & 0 \\ -2 & \frac{1}{2} & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{3}\cdot 6 & \frac{2}{3}\cdot 0 & \frac{2}{3}\cdot 15 \\ \frac{2}{3}\cdot (-12) & \frac{2}{3}\cdot 6 & \frac{2}{3}\cdot 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2\cdot 3 & 2\cdot (-1) & 2\cdot 0 \\ 2\cdot (-2) & 2\cdot \frac{1}{2} & 2\cdot (-1)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 10 \\ -8 & 4 & 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}6 & -2 & 0 \\ -4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4+6 & 0-2 & 10+0 \\ -8-4 & 4+1 & 0-2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}10 & -2 & 10 \\ -12 & 5 & -2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
